# BODHI-S Attribution

The files in `csv/` are reproduced from **BODHI: Bharat Ontology for Disease
& Healthcare Informatics**, developed by [Eka Care](https://www.eka.care).

- Source: https://github.com/eka-care/BODHI
- Commit: `daca31c2a5a28876a0140135015518a44eb2d37d`
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International

- Intended use: non-commercial academic capstone analytics

The VITAL-specific specialty normalization and complaint aliases are original
sidecar configuration and are not part of the upstream BODHI dataset.
